summary: PR 2819 at f112ca15 is valid fused-QKV regression hardening but does not correct issue 31924. Its tests pass, while independent CPU and gfx950 execution reproduces the review: mapped incompatible layouts reach the ordinary loader unchanged, and BF16 exact-name QKV tensors bypass fused mapping. No runtime layout change is justified without the unavailable failing checkpoint tensor and its initial-load transform, so this PR preserves the valid tests and records the precise limitation.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit f112ca15, both fused-QKV shard routing and runtime-layout boundary tests passed.

On CPU and AMD gfx950, a mapped deliberately incompatible img_in.weight layout reached the ordinary loader and raised the empty AssertionError; an exact-name BF16-style to_q.weight loaded through the identity path.
The candidate's valid fused-routing and ordinary-loader boundary regressions were preserved against the prepared base; 2 tests passed.
The proposed test and report changes contain no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The independent candidate reproduction ran parameter and loaded tensors on cuda:0, reported AMD Instinct MI350X and gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, reproduced the mapped-layout empty AssertionError, and validated the exact-name identity load.

remaining_limitations: Qwen-Image and FLUX.2-klein-base-4B weights were unavailable, so the historical full-model HTTP 400 was not replayed and the exact failing transformer tensor remains unidentified.

The arbitrary transposed fixture proves only that the generic updater does not guess layouts; it does not identify a correct transpose or reshape for a real checkpoint, so no speculative runtime transform was added.

The secondary text-encoder/VAE silent-drop behavior is not qualified as fixed; the prepared updater still builds its lookup from named_parameters and does not invoke architecture-specific startup load_weights logic.
The ROCm update_weights_from_disk standalone test remains skipped pending an evidence-backed transformer correction and a full passing AMD run.
Layerwise offload, FSDP/DTensor, tensor parallel, multi-GPU, and multi-node behavior were not qualified by the focused fixture.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
